summary: ARTFUL premium gifting e-commerce (React+FastAPI+MongoDB) — end-to-end backend + frontend testing. 33/33 backend pytest cases pass; full guest checkout flow (DEV OTP + mock-pay), COD, tracking, coupon WELCOME10, admin login/dashboard/products/orders/coupons and cross-customer security all verified live via UI. Razorpay & Twilio are correctly in DEV mode (labelled 'Demo'/'DEV OTP' as expected) — not treated as failures per spec.

backend_endpoints_tested: POST /api/checkout/mock-pay (idempotent, no double stock deduction verified)
frontend_flows_tested: Search: search-trigger -> search-input-field -> /search with search-instead + search-count + typo correction displayed
Cart page: coupon-input, apply-coupon-btn, cartpage-total. WELCOME10 -> ₹1,399 -> ₹1,259 (-₹140)

Guest checkout end-to-end: checkout-phone-input -> checkout-send-otp -> Demo OTP shown inline -> checkout-otp-input + checkout-verify-otp -> address fields -> payment-razorpay -> place-order-btn -> /order-success/ART-2026-00005 with order-success-container + order-number
Account page: account-nav-profile, account-nav-orders, account-nav-addresses, account-nav-wishlist all present
Track order: track-order-number + track-phone + track-submit -> track-result rendered
Admin login (admin-email/password/login-btn) -> /admin dashboard with stats (stat-total-revenue, stat-this-month, stat-total-orders, stat-customers) and full admin-nav-* set

critical_code_review_comments: Real testid for checkout phone is `checkout-phone-input` (not `checkout-mobile-input` as review request said). No functional issue — just a doc/spec mismatch; recommend aligning the spec text with the actual testid so future testing agents don't waste time. Similar: request mentioned `checkout-mobile-input` explicitly.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') — consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, informational).
CORS is `allow_origins=['*']` with `allow_credentials=False`. Acceptable for stateless JWT header auth, but if cookie/session ever added, this must tighten to explicit origins.

routers_shop.py `create_payment_order` reserves inventory before payment intent creation — good — but there is no timed release of reservations if the customer abandons after create-order without calling mock-pay. Consider a cron/janitor to release stale reserved stock after N minutes (not a blocker for MVP).
test_customer_cannot_access_other_order confirms 404 for cross-customer access. Admin routes correctly return 401/403 without token. Security posture is good.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@artful.com / Artful@2026. Customer: OTP via DEV mode (POST /api/auth/otp/send returns dev_otp; UI shows 'Demo OTP: XXXXXX').
seed_data_creation: Created test products via admin API (TEST_Product_*), test coupons (TEST*****), and 5 guest orders (ART-2026-00001..00005) during testing. Idempotent — no data corruption.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 33 backend API tests pass in ~3.5s (see /app/backend/tests/test_artful_api.py). Full checkout works via DEV mock-pay; frontend testid for phone input is `checkout-phone-input`. Coupon WELCOME10 seeded (10% off, min cart 999, capped at ₹500). Playwright note: use `page.evaluate("...click()")` if `force=True` click fails with 'Element outside of viewport' (happens on some fixed-position CTAs — DOM click works fine).
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Only minor spec/testid docstring mismatch: review request referenced `checkout-mobile-input` but implementation uses `checkout-phone-input` — cosmetic doc issue only, actual UX is fine.
